title: Mock Hackathon 2026
listingDescription: Student teams tackled real-world challenges through collaboration and coding.
description: A hands-on technical event that brought together student teams to solve real-world challenges through innovation, collaboration and coding.
overview: The Mock Hackathon 2026 provided students with an opportunity to experience a hackathon environment. Participants worked in teams, explored problem statements across multiple technical domains, and developed solutions through creativity, collaboration and technical skills.

highlights.title: Exploring the challenges
highlights.description: Teams examined problem statements across multiple technical domains and identified opportunities to build practical solutions.

highlights.title: Building as a team
highlights.description: Students combined their technical skills and ideas to develop solutions collaboratively.

highlights.title: Practicing rapid problem-solving
highlights.description: The event encouraged practical learning, teamwork and critical thinking while giving participants first-hand experience of a hackathon.
